knowledge.name: Frozen synthetic workforce roster
knowledge.detail: Ten fictional consultants provide IDs, levels, skills, rates, utilization, status, projects, end dates, targets, and bench costs.

knowledge.name: Synthetic pipeline and workforce rules
knowledge.detail: Fixed project endings, weighted opportunities, role needs, matching rules, pathway costs, and scenario values ground every result.

knowledge.name: L1 blueprint and locked evidence
knowledge.detail: The solution architecture, five operation skills, two knowledge files, and five validated cases define the supported planning scope.

intelligence_processing.name: Utilization and target analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates firm and level utilization, target gaps, billable headcount, bench headcount, availability, and monthly bench cost.

intelligence_processing.name: Capacity and demand forecasting
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares ninety-day project endings with weighted pipeline starts, probabilities, durations, and exact role requirements.

intelligence_processing.name: Bench skill and cost analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Inventories available consultants and skills while calculating monthly, annualized, and illustrative revenue scenarios.

intelligence_processing.name: Qualified staffing matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches bench consultants only when both skill and level meet a pipeline need and counts each consultant once.

intelligence_processing.name: Workforce pathway modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Models upskilling, internal innovation, cost, target demand, and synthetic payback options for unmatched resources.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio planning conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Operations, resource, and finance leaders invoke five bounded workflows through a validated Draft conversational agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent runs locally through Brainstem chat and API surfaces with bundled synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Manager-led review workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Resource managers inspect matches, unmatched people, capacity, costs, and pathways before any staffing or development decision.

management_reporting.name: Resource Utilization Dashboard
management_reporting.detail: Reports firm and level utilization, targets, gaps, headcount, bench status, availability, and monthly carrying cost.

management_reporting.name: Capacity Forecast
management_reporting.detail: Reports upcoming project endings alongside weighted pipeline demand, start dates, durations, probabilities, and role totals.

management_reporting.name: Bench Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports named bench resources, skill inventory, carrying-cost exposure, and explicitly synthetic revenue opportunity.

management_reporting.name: Staffing and Workforce Plan
management_reporting.detail: Reports candidate matches and capability-building options for manager review; no staffing assignment or approval occurs.

tools.name: ResourceUtilizationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: A portable Python BasicAgent exposes five deterministic planning operations over bundled synthetic evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: The local-first RAPP server discovers the tool and provides chat, streaming, health, and isolated validation surfaces.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational agent, two uploaded knowledge files, and five operation skills; validated artifacts remain Draft.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Approved production seam for project and resource context; current solution evidence uses frozen synthetic data.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Supports governed staffing and development review; the agent does not contact people, assign work, or send messages.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by deployment environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used to route requests and present grounded planning results.

supporting_features.name: Explicit five-operation routing
supporting_features.detail: A fixed enum routes utilization, capacity, bench, staffing-match, or workforce-plan requests.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: The package forbids web search, live HR or PSA queries, enrichment, and invention beyond the frozen evidence snapshot.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic matching controls
supporting_features.detail: Matches require exact level and skill fit, respect requested role counts, and prevent consultant double-counting.

supporting_features.name: Manager review and human approval
supporting_features.detail: Resource managers and authorized leaders retain every staffing, training, internal-work, revenue, and investment decision.

supporting_features.name: No staffing assignment boundary
supporting_features.detail: The agent never assigns, reserves, deploys, reallocates, hires, terminates, evaluates, contacts, or changes records.

supporting_features.name: Scenario and commitment labeling
supporting_features.detail: Pipeline, utilization, revenue, cost, and payback values remain synthetic planning scenarios rather than commitments.

supporting_features.name: Locked five-case Draft validation
supporting_features.detail: All five workflows passed Copilot Studio preview and strict Brainstem evidence checks while publication remained disabled.
